newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended generally firmer in quiet trade, with major markets in the U.S. and U.K. closed for holidays.

The market gained as the Swiss franc remained strong. Activity concentrated on domestic issues, including a new 500 million Swiss franc issue for Swiss Re. The 10-year domestic bond, with a 3-3/4 percent maturity, yielded 3.69 percent at issue. It was priced 18 basis points over comparable government bonds. In late trade it was quoted by lead CSFB at 13 basis points over governments.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 up 19 at 112.25
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 unchanged at 98.45.
